newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Labour concedes defeat to Act in Wgtn Central.
newsitem.headline: NZ Labour concedes defeat to Act in Wgtn Central.

text.p: Labour candidate Alick Shaw said on Saturday he had conceded defeat to Act's Richard Prebble in the Wellington Central constituency.

TV3 reported that at 11.30 p.m. (1030 GMT), with 47 percent of the electorate votes counted, Prebble was in front with 4,265 votes. Shaw was second with 3,040 and National's Mark Thomas was third with 2,275 votes.
Shaw said he went to Prebble's election night party at the Chicago bar in central Wellington to concede defeat, but was turned away at the door.
"Our people were denied entrance to the facility here tonight. I have to tell you I find it a disgraceful end to what generally been a well-conducted campaign in Wellington Central," Shaw said.
